scope.experience: A configured agent classifying new expense records and updating a connected table
scope.task: Read a new expense record, select a category using configured rules, write it to the designated field and inspect the run activity.
scope.configuration: Legacy Agents experience with an explicit trigger, defined categories and connected-table read/write actions; human review of ambiguous cases. Zapier documents migration to AI by Zapier, which is not assessed here.
scope.audience_perspective: A business operator configuring and reviewing an automated workflow

conversational.rationale: Natural-language instructions help configure the agent, but ordinary runs are triggered workflows rather than open-ended user conversations.
conversational.uncertainty: Chat-driven Agents use would have a more conversational profile; the replacement product is excluded.

specialization.rationale: Although the platform is general-purpose, this explicitly configured product experience is narrowly limited to expense categories and a designated table.
specialization.uncertainty: This is a profile of the configured agent, not an aggregate score for every Zapier workflow.

autonomy.rationale: An enabled agent can read, choose field values and write records across connected apps without per-record instructions, within its configured tool boundary.
autonomy.uncertainty: Triggers, approvals and allowed actions determine actual autonomy. Ambiguous cases and failures are assumed to need human intervention.

accessibility.rationale: No-code setup reduces programming requirements, but connected-account permissions, workflow design and business data knowledge limit the audience.
accessibility.uncertainty: Legacy availability and migration affect access; no setup or usability trials were performed.

explainability.rationale: Activity views expose run status, actions, selected fields and execution details that an operator can inspect.
explainability.uncertainty: Logs show actions rather than a proven faithful explanation of category choices; external-source and model details can remain opaque.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: legacy Zapier Agents expense-classification configuration with bounded table actions and review of ambiguous records. Documentation announces migration to AI by Zapier; that replacement is excluded. Scores are design estimates. Sources: https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/26028298697485-Use-actions-on-Zapier-Agents and https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/33336184962573-Review-your-agent-s-activity .
